project.name: CallBridge
project.summary: ChatGPT makes the information-gathering phone call you do not want to make while the webpage keeps you in control.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT as the WebMCP agent and OpenAI Realtime gpt-realtime-2.1-mini for the multilingual voice inquiry.
project.codex_usage: Codex collaborated on product design, WebMCP and telephony implementation, safety tests, responsive UI, browser QA, release gates, and submission preparation.
